verdict.rationale: Poly documents a Journaling feature in Mind, described as "a quiet place to document your day-to-day life" where new entries are saved as Markdown files. That covers journaling as a capture spot, but nothing shows the entries are created automatically per day or pre-filled from a template. Missing for 10: automatic one-note-per-day creation, template pre-fill, daily note as the default landing/capture destination, independent or hands-on corroboration.
